description: The spec models the site extension install PUT without a body, but Microsoft.Web answers a bodyless PUT with an empty 400; it requires a JSON body (`{}`). Declaring an optional `properties` member makes the client send `{}`.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Site extension install request properties (none are required).
